channel.title: Creators Lab
channel.description: Science, art, sound, design and culture, and the people shaping all five. New stories every day, a podcast every second Thursday and a quarterly magazine.

item.title: After the storm: what Strawberry Fields 2026 says about the Australian boutique festival
item.description: A sold-out weekend on the Murray brought a new quadraphonic stage, a fearlessly eclectic bill and a Friday night storm that put four people in hospital. The festival kept going. Here is what the weekend tells us.

item.title: CORE lands in Melbourne: inside Tomorrowland’s first Australian outing
item.description: Next Saturday, Tomorrowland’s house and techno offshoot makes its Australian debut at Flemington. The sold-out show is a test of whether a Belgian festival world can travel this far from home, and the lineup suggests it has done its homework.

item.title: fumi and the art of moving fast
item.description: She taught herself to DJ on a borrowed controller only a few years ago. Now the Boston-raised, Berlin-based DJ plays Berghain and Awakenings, and this week she lands in Australia for four very different rooms.

item.title: Juan Atkins, 1962 to 2026: the man who named the future
item.description: The Detroit producer who gave techno its first records, its first label and its name has died in Mexico City at 64. For four decades he argued that the machines were there to serve the soul.

item.title: The three typefaces this site is set in
item.description: One for the interface, one for reading and one for the name: the type behind Creators Lab.

item.title: Partial reprogramming, explained
item.description: How a tool for making stem cells became longevity science’s biggest bet, what it has shown so far, and what could go wrong.

item.title: The Creators Lab 01 cover, in detail
item.description: Four floating islands, a guitarist, a reader and a creature with a mug: a closer look at Joe Taylor’s cover for our first issue.

item.title: Joe Taylor’s soft, strange worlds
item.description: The Berlin animator and illustrator whose soft, strange worlds never quite sit still.

item.title: Detroit Dust on a Melbourne Floor
item.description: Fourteen years after a rare 2012 visit, the Detroit house icon returns for CORE Melbourne and a Sunday session at the Forum.

item.title: Rewinding the Cell
item.description: Twenty years after a Kyoto lab found a way to reset a cell’s clock, the idea has reached its first human patients. Now comes the hard part: proving it works.
